row_matching: PO rows by supplied line ID; summary fields by labeled template cells
identity_policy: supplied PO line IDs are authoritative and must remain unique across schedule, log, and provenance
status_policy: Accept readable status vocabulary by semantic role: changed/modified/revised, inserted/new/added, or unchanged/retained. Revision-log change types must still distinguish quantity, insertion, and unit-price changes.
page_policy: Accept a numeric page or a readable page expression such as p. 1, page 1, or a composite source-page-line string.
provenance_policy: The authoritative line-ID column and the rest of the provenance row are evaluated together. The row must uniquely identify the changed line, correct addendum filename, correct page, and a non-empty readable locator; no single field must repeat every component and exact private locator strings are not required.
formula_policy: Formula-linked line and schedule totals are evaluated independently of optional status wording when the keyed revised rows and numeric semantics are correct.
